dict.string: AI Sleep Coach reads sleep stages, heart rate, HRV, blood oxygen, respiratory rate, wrist temperature and breathing-disturbance data from Apple Health to score last night and flag possible breathing disturbances. Data stays on your devices.
AI Sleep Coach saves sleep sessions it records so they appear in Apple Health. It does not write a second copy of sleep Apple Watch already stored.
AI Sleep Coach uses wrist motion during an overnight session to estimate restlessness.
